pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Avoid Stating Unverified Historical Promotion Prices
lesson.when: Answering customer inquiries about previous price quotes or expired promotions without explicit source evidence for the specific past price amount
lesson.do: State only verified information such as current pricing and promo expiration status based on available tool results
lesson.otherwise: Acknowledge the price change due to the expired promotion without confirming specific unverified past price amounts
